clare (docs): Heads-up — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 is failing the docs-preview job on CI. It's the migration guide update (SDK snippet) but I can't reproduce locally. Anyone seen this error?

mike (eng): taking a look. which runner/py version? sometimes the preview uses the actions image not matching local env.

clare (docs): CI log shows `docs-preview` job error: 'sphinxcontrib.httpdomain not found' even though requirements.txt lists it.

ci-bot: docs-preview check *failed* — generation error in docs/migration/sdk.md: import error: No module named 'sphinxcontrib.httpdomain' (job id 8921).

jenna (devex): for reproduction try `pip install -r docs/requirements.txt && make -C docs html` — that mirrors the GH action we use. Also `make docs-serve` will run the same build step locally.

mike (eng): I ran that inside the container image used by actions and got the same failure. The requirements file pins `sphinx==4.5` but our action runner recently bumped to python 3.11 and sphinx plugin compatibility is flaky.

sam (platform): this is also why auto-merge kept trying to merge despite docs-preview failing? We have a rule that auto-merge only needs CI passing, but docs-preview is marked as optional in branch protection currently.

clare (docs): oh — so the PR got the `automerge/ready` label, and GH tried to auto-merge because required checks (unit, lint) passed, but docs-preview is optional. We should not auto-merge migration guide changes without docs-preview green.

jenna (devex): agreed. Proposal: 1) make `docs-preview` a required check for the `main` branch and protected release branches for docs PRs owned by CODEOWNERS; 2) adjust auto-merge rules so `docs-only` label still requires docs-preview; 3) add a quick pre-submit GH Action to assert that docs build locally in a matrix matching the action runner.

mike (eng): sounds good. For (3) we can add a lightweight step called `docs-smoke` that runs in ~30s using a slim env to catch missing deps. Example: ```yaml
# .github/workflows/docs-preview.yml snippet
name: docs-preview
jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Install minimal deps
        run: pip install -r docs/requirements.txt --no-deps
      - name: Build docs smoke
        run: make -C docs html
```

sam (platform): +1. Also suggest updating CODEOWNERS so docs changes hit the docs team reviewers first. Current file has `docs/* @eng-docs` but some migration guides live in `docs/migration/*` owned by `@platform-docs`. Let's propose a more specific line: `/docs/migration/ @docs-team @devex` so the right folks get tagged.

clare (docs): here's a CODEOWNERS line I can open a tiny PR for: ```/docs/migration/ @clare-docs @jenna-devex``` — that'll ensure docs reviewers are required.

mike (eng): And we should update branch protection to mark `docs-preview` and `docs-smoke` as required. That will prevent auto-merge until they pass. Right now auto-merge rules are tied to the `automerge/ready` label; we can change the automation to check for `status: success` for the specific required checks.

jenna (devex): small UX note: we should keep a fallback so when docs-preview action is flaky we can still merge urgent fixes manually with an override process (e.g., require 2 approvals and a release manager sign-off).

clare (docs): action items: (1) I will open the CODEOWNERS tweak PR; (2) mike, can you add `docs-smoke` to the workflow and make `docs-preview` strict? (3) sam, can you update branch protection to include those checks? I'll hold off on re-adding `automerge/ready` until green. @ci-bot can you re-run the docs-preview after the workflow change? :pray:

mike (eng): yep I'll draft the workflow change now and push to a branch.

sam (platform): will queue the branch protection update for review with security.

ci-bot: re-run queued for https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 — docs-preview re-run scheduled.

clare (docs): thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll put a note on the PR that auto-merge is paused. :thumbsup:
